desc: Ideation: confirm DSU + multiples approach is correct and efficient.
Build a hash map `pos` mapping value → index for O(1) lookup.
Initialize DSU of size n; for each v > threshold, mark as singleton (no edges).
Iterate through `nums`; for each value v ≤ threshold, for each multiple m = 2v, 3v, … up to threshold, if m exists in `pos`, union the current index with `pos[m]`.
After processing, count unique parents via `find(i)` for all i.
Return the count of distinct components.
